items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I think when Bardu Ali was there I think they used to have stage shows every night.

ctx.x: There wasn't ever a period when there was live entertainment every day?
Yes, sometimes there would be. Yes, sometimes where would be. It depended, you know, on who. Now,
as I say, I think when Bardu Ali was there I think they used to have stage shows every night. The shows would run for maybe a week or two, you know, at a time.
